title: Man arrested for illegal possession of loaded revolver in Palawan

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Police arrested a 38-year-old man for possessing an unlicensed firearm after responding to a reported disturbance at a passenger terminal in the town of Busuanga in Palawan on Friday. The suspect was found carrying a loaded .38-caliber revolver with two live hollow-point bullets when police officers from the Busuanga Municipal Police Station arrived at the Salvacion Terminal in Barangay Salvacion at around 12:58 a.m., the Palawan Police Provincial Office said.
